title: Giant Industries Ciniza refinery — isolation-state verification challenge

source.issuer: U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board
source.binding_method: official CSB domain + report number + release date + source locators

source_locators.fact: The operator used wrench orientation to infer valve state; the valve was actually open. A mechanic observed the valve position indicator showing open and did not communicate that observation.
Locks and tags were applied and the mechanics believed the valve-closing task had been completed, although they had not observed the operator closing the valve.
After flow through the vent hose subsided, personnel believed the pump was depressurized; the CSB later found the vent line was plugged and the pump was not depressurized.
The CSB concluded that isolation and depressurization had not been adequately verified before lockout/tagout.
The lessons learned call for effective verification that equipment is isolated, depressurized, and drained.

historical_boundary.human_belief_at_time: The pump was treated as isolated and depressurized and therefore ready for removal.
contemporaneous_counterevidence: a mechanic observed the valve position indicator showing the suction valve open but did not communicate the observation
post_incident_findings: isolation and depressurization were not adequately verified

frozen_contract_probe.reason: The public record contains a human belief of closed/isolation, contradictory contemporaneous position-indicator evidence, and later findings about the actual physical state. Assigning a historical boolean would collapse evidence provenance and knowledge state or import hindsight.

paygod_execution.reason: No faithful frozen B2 input is produced by coercing this maintenance-isolation record into a Gas Site Readiness boolean. The challenge is diagnostic and non-gating.

gap.observed_fact: Personnel treated the equipment as isolated and depressurized, while contemporaneous physical-state evidence conflicted with that belief and was not effectively incorporated into the decision.
gap.why_current_contract_cannot_resolve_it: The frozen boolean can carry a declared isolation-readiness state, but it does not encode how the physical state was observed, whether observations conflict, or what evidence was available to the decision maker.

non_claims: This maintenance-isolation workflow is not identical to the frozen Gas Site Readiness workflow.
This case does not count toward the B2 real-case minimum.
PayGod did not discover the incident cause and no automated physical-state detection is claimed.
The CSB report is used as an independent historical challenge source, not as proof of production source attestation or trusted time.
No kernel change is authorized by this single challenge.
